attribution: the source run directory is named gpt-5_20260422_154635 and predict_from_detection.py sets the model; no model id is recorded inside the response files
what: the pipeline oracle: gpt-5 reading the UNPROTECTED image and predicting a label for every pair it detects. This is the stage whose output drives defense.py, so it is the reference the defense is built against.
boxes: NO ground-truth boxes: this stage runs its OWN person detector, so detection misses mean some ground-truth pairs never receive an answer. This is a different protocol from the other raw evaluators, which are handed ground-truth boxes and can answer every pair.

all_pairs.note: every pair the detector missed is scored as wrong. Comparable in denominator to the other raw evaluators, but penalises detection failure as if it were a classification error.

answered_pairs_only.note: conditions on the pairs the detector found. Closest to a like-for-like classification comparison against the other raw evaluators, but on a self-selected and easier subset.

three_way_grouping: intimate {friends, family-members, couple} / non-intimate {professional, commercial} / no-relation {no-relationship}
copied_from: process/<image_id>/round1_full_img.json in this artifact; the files are byte-identical
